value.rationale: The 2026 paper explicitly motivates symmetric nondeterministic resolution and noncommutative deterministic error algebra. Its chosen five-state refinement realizes just three of four possible directional success/error responses. The minimum extra cost is not the naive one new reverse-McCarthy state: associativity forces a distinct composite-error state. A fully explicit optimum small algebra can be used for algebraic analysis of both directional masking policies; the conditional minimum and limitation to one-step probes are precise.
